suite: chinook/cases.json with invoice_line, media_type, playlist_track renamed to the warehouse names
schema:
tenant=chinook
tables:
  - Invoice: Customer invoices (one row per sale)
      InvoiceId: int — Primary key
      CustomerId: int
      InvoiceDate: datetime
      BillingAddress: str [pii=high]
      BillingCity: str [pii=low]
      BillingState: str [pii=low]
      BillingCountry: str
      BillingPostalCode: str [pii=high]
      Total: float [USD] — Invoice total
  - invoice_line: Line items on an invoice (one row per track sold)
      InvoiceLineId: int — Primary key
      InvoiceId: int
      TrackId: int
      UnitPrice: float [USD]
      Quantity: int
  - Customer: Customers
      CustomerId: int — Primary key
      FirstName: str [pii=low]
      LastName: str [pii=low]
      Company: str [pii=low]
      Address: str [pii=high]
      City: str [pii=low]
      State: str [pii=low]
      Country: str
      PostalCode: str [pii=high]
      Phone: str [pii=high]
      Fax: str [pii=high]
      Email: str [pii=high]
      SupportRepId: int — Employee who supports this customer
  - Employee: Staff, including sales support representatives
      EmployeeId: int — Primary key
      LastName: str [pii=low]
      FirstName: str [pii=low]
      Title: str — Job title
      ReportsTo: int — Manager EmployeeId
      BirthDate: datetime [pii=high]
      HireDate: datetime
      Address: str [pii=high]
      City: str [pii=low]
      State: str [pii=low]
      Country: str
      PostalCode: str [pii=high]
      Phone: str [pii=high]
      Fax: str [pii=high]
      Email: str [pii=high]
  - Track: Individual tracks that can be sold
      TrackId: int — Primary key
      Name: str — Track title
      AlbumId: int
      MediaTypeId: int → label via media_type.Name
      GenreId: int → label via Genre.Name
      Composer: str [pii=low]
      Milliseconds: int — Track length
      Bytes: int
      UnitPrice: float [USD]
  - Album: Albums
      AlbumId: int — Primary key
      Title: str — Album title
      ArtistId: int → label via Artist.Name
  - Artist: Recording artists (prefer group-by label: Artist.Name)
      ArtistId: int — Primary key
      Name: str — Artist name
  - Genre: Music genres (prefer group-by label: Genre.Name)
      GenreId: int — Primary key
      Name: str — Genre name
  - media_type: File/media formats a track is available in (prefer group-by label: media_type.Name)
      MediaTypeId: int — Primary key
      Name: str — Media type name
  - Playlist: Curated playlists (prefer group-by label: Playlist.Name)
      PlaylistId: int — Primary key
      Name: str — Playlist name
  - playlist_track: Which tracks belong to which playlist
      PlaylistId: int
      TrackId: int
synonyms (use these mappings):
  - 'revenue' → Invoice.Total — Invoice revenue
  - 'sales' → Invoice.Total
  - 'sales' → invoice_line.UnitPrice
  - 'revenue' → invoice_line.UnitPrice — Line revenue per track sold (Quantity is always 1); use for revenue by track, genre, artist or album
  - 'spend' → Invoice.Total
  - 'genre' → Genre.Name
  - 'music genre' → Genre.Name
  - 'artist' → Artist.Name
  - 'album' → Album.Title
  - 'track' → Track.Name
  - 'playlist' → Playlist.Name
  - 'media type' → media_type.Name
  - 'billing country' → Invoice.BillingCountry
  - 'customer country' → Customer.Country
  - 'country' → Customer.Country
  - 'countries' → Customer.Country
  - 'quantity' → invoice_line.Quantity
  - 'quantities' → invoice_line.Quantity
  - 'city' → Customer.City
  - 'state' → Customer.State
  - 'sold' → invoice_line.TrackId
  - 'employee' → Employee
  - 'employees' → Employee
  - 'headcount' → Employee
  - 'customer' → Customer
  - 'customers' → Customer
  - 'client' → Customer
  - 'clients' → Customer
approved_metrics (prefer metric_id when the question matches):
  - total_revenue
  - invoice_count
  - employee_count
  - revenue_by_country
  - revenue_by_billing_country
  - revenue_by_genre
  - avg_revenue_per_customer
  - line_item_revenue
instructions (follow these; they are not SQL):
  - Tracks sold and quantities sold come from invoice_line (one row per track on an invoice), not Track.
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Invoice.CustomerId → Customer.CustomerId
  - invoice_line.InvoiceId → Invoice.InvoiceId
  - invoice_line.TrackId → Track.TrackId
  - Customer.SupportRepId → Employee.EmployeeId
  - Track.GenreId → Genre.GenreId
  - Track.AlbumId → Album.AlbumId
  - Track.MediaTypeId → media_type.MediaTypeId
  - Album.ArtistId → Artist.ArtistId
  - playlist_track.TrackId → Track.TrackId
  - playlist_track.PlaylistId → Playlist.PlaylistId

WITH yearly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('YEAR', i.InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue
  FROM workspace.default.invoice_line il
  JOIN workspace.default.invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  WHERE i.InvoiceDate IS NOT NULL
    AND (date_trunc('YEAR', i.InvoiceDate) = '2023-01-01' OR date_trunc('YEAR', i.InvoiceDate) = '2024-01-01')
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 100 * TRY_DIVIDE(
  (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2024-01-01') - (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2023-01-01'),
  (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = '2023-01-01')
) AS percent_growth_2023_to_2024;
